name: Amendment Of Undertaking
definition: Modification of an undertaking such as an guarantee or standby letter of credit.

ChangeOfAmount.name: Change Of Amount
ChangeOfAmount.definition: Decrease (negative) or increase (positive) of the undertaking as a result of the amendment.

BeneficiaryConsentRequestIndicator.name: Beneficiary Consent Request Indicator
BeneficiaryConsentRequestIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not a request for consent is required from the beneficiary.
